messages.subject: Project Harbor - completion checklist for 19 January
messages.plaintextBody:
Fiona,

We're on track for an Effective Date of Monday 19 January. Outstanding from your side: the signed solvency certificate (two directors), confirmation the £5m from the family holdco has hit the blocked account, and the executed board minutes. We'll handle the debentures and the Tenterden charge engrossments.

Could you confirm the £5m timing? Pennine want it in the blocked account by the 14th.

Elena

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
